claim_text: As of August 27, 2026, USAO-MN identified Abdihakim Ali Ahmed, Ahmed Abdullahi Ghedi, and Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim as the 24th, 25th, and 26th Feeding Our Future defendants sentenced.

supporting_passages.quote: USAO-MN described Ahmed, Ghedi, and Omar-Hashim as the 24th, 25th, and 26th Feeding Our Future defendants sentenced.
supporting_passages.locator: press release body, Three Defendants in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme Sentenced to Total of 155 Months' Imprisonment

qualifiers: This is an official DOJ ordinal milestone stated outright by the source, not a value derived by this corpus through addition, subtraction, or roster reconciliation.

Charged, convicted, and sentenced are overlapping procedural stages of the same population, not additive groups; do not sum or subtract this value against the charged or convicted metrics to infer a 'pending' count.

A later individual sentencing does not by itself change this published ordinal, even when this corpus has separately and canonically archived that later sentencing (see claim-fof-hussein-couple-sentencing-2026-09-08). Only an explicit newer DOJ statement of a higher sentenced-count ordinal supersedes this record. As of the 2026-09-10 official-source sweep, no such statement had been published.
This claim covers only the Feeding Our Future investigation; it does not include Housing Stabilization Services or any other program.
public_explanation: DOJ identified Abdihakim Ali Ahmed, Ahmed Abdullahi Ghedi and Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim as the 24th, 25th and 26th defendants sentenced.
